description_en: Korean name of the tourist attraction. Used as the unit for place fixed effects.
notes: Primary grouping variable; maps to places.json via naver_id.

description_en: Anonymised reviewer identifier. Used to detect multiple reviews from the same user and to compute reviewer-level aggregates.
notes: Format: u#### (assigned during scraping).

description_en: Date the review was collected by the scraper. Not the review date.
notes: Used for data provenance only; not in models.

source: scraped — reviewer-entered field on Naver Place
description_en: Date of visit as reported by the reviewer when posting. Missing if reviewer did not fill in.
notes: Source of visit_month and season dummies.

description_en: Calendar month of visit.
notes: Used to construct season dummies.

description_en: 1 if visit_date falls on Saturday or Sunday, 0 otherwise.
notes: Dummy variable for weekend effect.

description_en: Number of user reactions (likes / helpful / etc.) the review has received. Highly right-skewed; median = 0.
notes: Dependent variable in M4 (negative binomial). Used with ln_review_age as offset.

source: scraped — Naver Place badge on review
description_en: Raw verification badge text as scraped. Expanded into verif_receipt and verif_reservation dummies.
notes: See verif_receipt and verif_reservation.

description_en: Cumulative number of photos the reviewer has uploaded to Naver Place across all reviews. Logged as ln_user_photos.
notes: Raw count; use ln_user_photos in models.

description_en: Number of users following this reviewer on Naver Place. Logged as ln_user_followers.
notes: Raw count; use ln_user_followers in models.

description_en: 1 if the review includes any free-text body, 0 if it is tag-only.
notes: Key predictor in M2: writing text is hypothesised to increase keyword count.

description_en: Full review text as scraped from Naver Place. Korean or English. Used to compute sentiment and ln_length.
notes: Not directly used as a model variable; source for ln_length and sentiment.

description_en: Number of times the reviewer reports having visited this attraction. Used to derive revisit.
notes: Source of revisit. Missing means the reviewer did not fill in the field.

source: scraped — star rating widget on Naver Place
description_en: Star rating given by the reviewer. Not present in all reviews (~32% have a rating).
notes: Dependent variable in M3 (ordered logistic). Null rows excluded from M3.

description_en: Number of keyword tags the reviewer selected from the platform's predefined list. Operationalises information diversity (Lee et al., 2026).
notes: Dependent variable in M2 (ordered logistic).

description_en: Raw text of the selected keyword tags, e.g. '뷰가 좋아요 | 볼거리가 많아요'. Used to construct tag_* theme dummies.
notes: Source for tag_visual … tag_water dummies.

source: scraped — photo count on the review
description_en: Number of photos attached to this specific review (not the reviewer's total). Logged as ln_photos.
notes: Raw count; use ln_photos in models.

description_en: Cumulative total reviews written by this reviewer on Naver Place. Logged as ln_user_reviews.
notes: Raw count; use ln_user_reviews in models.

source: derived — presence of companion / purpose fields
description_en: 1 if the reviewer filled in at least one structured visit field (companion type or visit purpose). Signals willingness to share visit context.
notes: Highest VIF in the dataset (2.82); no multicollinearity concern.

source: scraped — wait checkbox on Naver Place
description_en: 1 if the reviewer reported waiting before entry or service.
notes: Significant negative predictor of revisit in M1 (OR = 0.51).

source: scraped — reservation checkbox on Naver Place
description_en: 1 if the reviewer made an advance reservation.
notes: Included in all models as IV.

description_en: 1 if the reviewer visited alone. Reference group omitted from companion dummies.
notes: Positive predictor of revisit in M1 (OR = 1.68).

description_en: 1 if visited with a romantic partner.
notes: One of the companion type dummies.

description_en: 1 if visited with friends.
notes: One of the companion type dummies.

description_en: 1 if visited with children.
notes: One of the companion type dummies.

description_en: 1 if visited with family.
notes: One of the companion type dummies.

description_en: 1 if visited with work colleagues.
notes: One of the companion type dummies.

description_en: 1 if the reviewer's stated purpose was tourism / travel.
notes: One of the visit purpose dummies.

description_en: 1 if the stated purpose was an outing (short leisure trip).
notes: One of the visit purpose dummies.

description_en: 1 if the stated purpose was a routine / everyday visit.
notes: One of the visit purpose dummies.

description_en: 1 if the stated purpose was a date.
notes: One of the visit purpose dummies.

description_en: 1 if the stated purpose was a social or group gathering.
notes: One of the visit purpose dummies.

source: derived from tags field — keyword theme classification
description_en: 1 if the reviewer selected at least one keyword in the visual/scenery cluster (e.g. 뷰가 좋아요, 자연 경관이 좋아요).
notes: One of 10 keyword theme dummies.

source: derived from tags field — keyword theme classification
description_en: 1 if the reviewer selected at least one keyword in the content/sightseeing cluster (e.g. 볼거리가 많아요).
notes: One of 10 keyword theme dummies.

source: derived from tags field — keyword theme classification
description_en: 1 if the reviewer selected at least one keyword in the crowded cluster (e.g. 방문객이 많아요).
notes: One of 10 keyword theme dummies.

source: derived from tags field — keyword theme classification
description_en: 1 if the reviewer selected at least one keyword in the quiet/peaceful cluster (e.g. 한적해요).
notes: One of 10 keyword theme dummies.

source: derived from tags field — keyword theme classification
description_en: 1 if the reviewer selected at least one keyword in the facilities cluster (e.g. 시설이 좋아요, 관리가 잘 되어있어요).
notes: One of 10 keyword theme dummies.

source: derived from tags field — keyword theme classification
description_en: 1 if the reviewer selected at least one keyword in the accessibility cluster (e.g. 주차하기 편해요, 대중교통으로 가기 편해요).
notes: One of 10 keyword theme dummies.

source: derived from tags field — keyword theme classification
description_en: 1 if the reviewer selected at least one keyword in the family-friendly cluster (e.g. 아이와 가기 좋아요).
notes: One of 10 keyword theme dummies.

source: derived from tags field — keyword theme classification
description_en: 1 if the reviewer selected at least one keyword in the value/price cluster (e.g. 가성비가 좋아요).
notes: One of 10 keyword theme dummies.

source: derived from tags field — keyword theme classification
description_en: 1 if the reviewer selected at least one keyword in the food cluster (e.g. 음식이 맛있어요).
notes: One of 10 keyword theme dummies.

source: derived from tags field — keyword theme classification
description_en: 1 if the reviewer selected at least one keyword in the water activities cluster (e.g. 물놀이하기 좋아요).
notes: One of 10 keyword theme dummies.

description_en: 1 if visit_count > 1 (the reviewer has visited this attraction more than once), 0 otherwise. Dependent variable in M1 (logistic regression).
notes: ~22% of all reviews are from revisitors.

description_en: Natural log of the character count of the review text. Captures reviewer effort; controls for verbosity in models using sentiment.
notes: Only defined for reviews where has_text = 1. Set to 0 or excluded otherwise depending on model.

description_en: Natural log of (n_photos + 1). Log-transform applied to reduce right skew of the raw photo count.
notes: +1 offset prevents log(0).

description_en: Natural log of the reviewer's cumulative review count. Captures reviewer experience and platform engagement. Strongest positive predictor in M1 (OR = 1.52).
notes: No +1 needed; user_reviews >= 1 by definition.

description_en: Natural log of (user_followers + 1). Proxy for the reviewer's social reach on Naver Place. Strongest predictor in M4 (IRR = 1.97).
notes: +1 offset prevents log(0); many reviewers have 0 followers.

description_en: Natural log of (user_photos + 1). Reviewer's overall photo-sharing activity on the platform.
notes: Included as a supplementary control; not a primary predictor.

range_values: traditional, nature, theme_park, beach, market, etc.
description_en: Broad attraction type coded manually in places.json. Absorbed by place fixed effects in all models; retained here for descriptive purposes.
notes: Not used as a model variable directly.

description_en: City where the attraction is located. Seoul = 25 attractions, Busan = 4. Absorbed by place fixed effects in all models.
notes: Used in geo_bubble visualisation.

description_en: 1 if visit occurred in June / July / August.
notes: One of three season dummies; spring (months 3–5) is the reference category.

description_en: 1 if visit occurred in September / October / November.
notes: One of three season dummies.

description_en: 1 if visit occurred in December / January / February.
notes: One of three season dummies.

description_en: 1 if the verification badge indicates an advance reservation.
notes: Split from raw verification field.

description_en: 1 if the verification badge indicates a receipt (confirmed purchase/entry).
notes: Split from raw verification field.

source: derived — log(days between visit_date and scraped_at)
description_en: Natural log of the number of days since the review was posted. Used as an exposure offset in M4 so that the model estimates reactions per unit of time, not raw reaction count.
notes: Reactions accumulate over time; without this offset older reviews are unfairly favoured.

source: NLP model — pre-trained Korean sentiment analyser applied to text
description_en: Polarity score of the review text. Near +1 = strongly positive, near -1 = strongly negative. Validated by correlation with rating (r = 0.51). Only available for reviews with text.
notes: Produced by 05_01_advanced_nlp.py. Reviews without text are excluded from models that use this variable.
